title: Streaming response with Amazon Bedrock and AWS Lambda function URLs
description: Create an LLM streaming response API with Lambda Function URLs.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how to use an Lambda Function URL streaming ability and Bedrock runtime `InvokeModelWithResponseStreamCommand` to build an LLM response streaming API.

This pattern deploys a Lambda Function. Since Bedrock access is limited to certain Regions, user must set BEDROCK_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and BEDROCK_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables for the Lambda Function to allow request across Regions.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
